detailed_descriptions.en: You’ve been invited to compete in the local folkrace. Can you successfully diversify your business ventures into the world of demolition racing? Folkrace is a single-player campaign expansion that introduces a ton of new vehicles and a series of destructive racing game modes against computer-controlled opponents. Test your mettle on the track against rival drivers and expand your car collection as you win championships. Features - New racing game modes and destructive challenges - Three new diverse patchwork racetracks - A collection of unique vehicles and vehicle skins, all fully upgradable - Enhanced vehicle destruction system and upgraded nitro gadgets - New missions and heists that help further your racing business - Löckelle Municipality hub expanded to include Granriket, a serene valley where life revolves around the automotive business

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
You’ve been invited to compete in the local folkrace. Can you successfully diversify your business ventures into the world of demolition racing?

Folkrace is a single-player campaign expansion that introduces a ton of new vehicles and a series of destructive racing game modes against computer-controlled opponents. Test your mettle on the track against rival drivers and expand your car collection as you win championships.

Features

- New racing game modes and destructive challenges
- Three new diverse patchwork racetracks
- A collection of unique vehicles and vehicle skins, all fully upgradable
- Enhanced vehicle destruction system and upgraded nitro gadgets
- New missions and heists that help further your racing business
- Löckelle Municipality hub expanded to include Granriket, a serene valley where life revolves around the automotive business
